sender: Curtis Whitlow, Director of Institutional Sales, Rowe & Whitlow Research
subject: Introducing Midstream & Utilities Research Pro - 20% off Q4 + free access to our Corporate Access Pass for new fund clients
body:
Hi Ellen,

I'm reaching out from Rowe & Whitlow Research. We're extending a limited Q4 offer to buy-side desks that don't yet subscribe to our energy infrastructure coverage.

What's new: Midstream & Utilities Research Pro bundles our 11 analysts' coverage of gathering and processing, pipelines, regulated utilities and independent power producers, with model access and a weekly call.

What you get:
- 52 initiated names, with live Excel models and a regulatory docket tracker
- Weekly Wednesday call with our lead analyst (open Q&A)
- Quarterly utility rate-case scorecard
- Corporate Access Pass: up to 12 management meetings per quarter, including non-deal roadshows with covered companies

Sample insight from last week's note: Permian gathering volumes were +3.2% q/q in Q2 and we expect +2.5% in Q3, with produced-water handling fees about 8% above our prior model. We rate our top pick, a Delaware Basin gatherer, Outperform, with a $41 target.

Offer: 20% off first-year Pro pricing if you sign by Oct 30. We can also set up a 15-minute demo with our lead analyst this week or next.

Would Thursday afternoon work?

Best,
Curtis Whitlow
Director, Institutional Sales | Rowe & Whitlow Research
